text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with fixed rules. A more advanced area, called deep learning, uses complex neural networks to handle things like speech recognition and self-driving cars. AI is already part of daily life: it recommends movies on streaming services, filters spam emails, powers virtual assistants, and helps doctors analyze medical scans. While AI is not perfect, it continues to grow rapidly, changing how we work, learn, and connect with the world.
